reverie.title: Reverie
reverie.alt: A dark-haired woman rests her head on her drawn-up knee, lit warmly against a near-black background, with a lit candle trailing smoke beside her.

soulbreak.title: Soulbreak
soulbreak.alt: A figure arches backwards to lift a shaft of white light, surrounded by billowing clouds of fire and smoke, with a phoenix rising from flames below.

samhain.title: Samhain
samhain.alt: In deep reds, a face tips back with eyes closed beneath outstretched crow wings and a hanging ankh, with a spiral of petals below.

revelation.title: Revelation
revelation.alt: A long-haired figure gazes upward, flanked by reaching hands: a shadowed skull on one side, a burning orange swirl on the other.

awaken.title: Awaken
awaken.alt: A woman lifts her face to a blazing sun in a blue sky, magnolia and lily blooms opening around her shoulders out of the darkness below.

omnibeat.title: Omnibeat
omnibeat.alt: A pale figure with bare branches growing from her head reaches towards the sun, a full moon resting in her other hand against a red ground.

visitation.title: Visitation
visitation.alt: A short-haired person in round glasses and a red top looks out at the viewer, a glowing pink neon butterfly beside them and a green street scene behind.

albedo.title: Albedo
albedo.alt: A silver-grey figure sits haloed in moonlight beneath a tree of serpentine branches, a golden phoenix perched facing her in the dark.

ponyland.title: Ponyland
ponyland.alt: A wide night scene of twisting trees around a glowing white lotus, with green horse-like spirits leaping through the branches.

renaissance.title: Renaissance
renaissance.alt: A figure stretches upward through swirling magenta and gold forms towards a descending dove, a peacock feather at the edge of the frame.

root-and-branch.title: Root and Branch
root-and-branch.alt: A seated woman's body becomes a tree, with small human figures curled among her roots and branches beneath a starlit sky.

emerge.title: Emerge
emerge.alt: A blonde woman with her eyes closed tilts her face upward, a white butterfly at her brow, a daisy behind her ear and red butterflies circling behind.

in-their-arms.title: In Their Arms
in-their-arms.alt: A nude figure lies curled and sleeping among snow-capped mountain peaks at sunset, her body merging with the rock.

web-of-being.title: Web of Being
web-of-being.alt: A face surfaces from a violet web of mycelium threads, with mushrooms and fungi growing out of the strands around it.

world-to-come.title: World to Come
world-to-come.alt: A woman crouches at a small fire in a forest clearing, looking up at a bright star and falling meteors in the night sky.
